course_outline_concepts: Taxonomy-as-seed: a third synthesis paradigm alongside seed-based (Self-Instruct) and no-seed (Magpie)
GLAN four-level tree expansion: Field -> Subfield -> Discipline -> Subject -> Session -> Concept -> Instruction
Nemotron-4 340B: >98% synthetic alignment corpus, RM-as-filter and RM-as-judge, generator/critic iteration
Phi-textbooks line: Phi-1 (code), Phi-1.5 (20K topics), Phi-3 (two-phase web -> synthetic), Phi-4 (50 categories, ~400B tokens)
Coverage vs imagination: top-down taxonomies guarantee coverage of curator-imagined branches, miss combinations a bottom-up seed pool would encounter
Taxonomies inject curator bias at the root — what the curator treats as a field frames everything downstream
Textbook-quality hypothesis: pretraining loss is quality-bounded before it is quantity-bounded
Cosmopedia as open reproduction: 30M prompts, 25B tokens, audience x format taxonomy, deduplication as the bottleneck

sources.what_to_extract: Four-level taxonomy (Field -> Subfield -> Discipline -> Subject -> Session -> Concept); no-seed synthesis; GPT-4 as both taxonomy curator and instruction generator; taxonomy-node-as-capability-knob; teacher bias concentrates at the root.

98% synthetic post-training; 20K human anchors; reward-model-as-filter and RM-as-judge; Genetic Instruct for code (self-instruct + WizardCoder mutations + LLM fitness); staged SFT (code SFT -> general SFT); DPO then RPO; generator/critic loop with iterated Nemotron checkpoints.

Phi-1: 6B filtered web + 1B synthetic Python textbooks + 180M synthetic exercises; textbook-quality classifier; TBAYN (Textbooks Are All You Need) framing; 50.6% HumanEval at 1.3B; HumanEval contamination critique.

Phi-1.5: 20K-topic seed list, ~20B synthetic tokens via GPT-3.5, extends textbook recipe from code to common-sense reasoning; ablation showing synthetic-only beats synthetic+web on reasoning; direct ancestor of GLAN's taxonomy formalism.

Phi-3: 3.8B / 7B / 14B; two-phase curriculum (Phase-1 filtered web, Phase-2 synthetic-heavy); synthetic generated by GPT-3.5/GPT-4-class teachers; 3.3T-4.8T tokens; 2GB at 4-bit quantization for on-device.

Phi-4: 14B, 50 synthetic categories, ~400B unweighted synthetic tokens; pivotal-token DPO; Phi-4-reasoning 1.4M prompts and 16B o3-mini-distilled tokens for SFT; 90-step GRPO is enough when SFT base is strong.

Cosmopedia: open reproduction; Mixtral-8x7B generator; 30M samples 25B tokens; three seed sources (curated educational + 145 web clusters + instruction/story seeds); audience x format taxonomy; deduplication as real bottleneck; structural prompt variation, not cosmetic.

Concept-graph extraction: topics x knowledge points as a 2K x 5K graph with co-occurrence weights; sampling rare edges for coverage; illustrates a domain-specific taxonomy built from seeds rather than pre-curated from the top.
